compiled_state.title: GREEN: Implement format-recipe-result.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
Create plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/format-recipe-result.sh — a bash helper that translates recipe-executor.sh JSON output to a human-readable summary compatible with completion-verifier input expectations.

## Why
TDD GREEN phase: implement the translation layer to make RED tests from the paired RED task pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Script exists at plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/format-recipe-result.sh and is executable (chmod +x)
- Accepts: RECIPE_NAME as first arg, executor JSON as stdin (reads from /dev/stdin)
- Outputs multi-line human-readable summary:
  - Line 1: Recipe task completed: <RECIPE_NAME> (<engine_name>)
  - Line 2: Status: SUCCESS | FAILED | DEGRADED
  - Line 3+: Files changed: <file list, comma-separated, or 'none'>
  - Line 4: Transforms applied: <N>
  - On FAILED: includes Errors: <error list> and note 'Pre-recipe git stash snapshot preserved — run git stash pop to revert'
  - On DEGRADED: includes engine_name and degraded status note
- Invalid JSON input exits 1 with error to stderr; success exits 0
- Uses python3 -c for JSON parsing (consistent with recipe-executor.sh pattern)
- All tests in test-format-recipe-result.sh pass

## File Impact
- CREATE: plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/format-recipe-result.sh

## Testing Mode
GREEN — make failing tests pass

## Dependencies
- RED tests task (depends_on)
